verifications.claim: Most Chili's locations are open on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Chili's is open on Easter in most regions'; R3: 'Chili’s Grill & Bar is expected to be open on Easter Sunday'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states open in most regions (equivalent to most locations); R3 supports expectation of openness without contradiction.

verifications.claim: Chili's typical Sunday hours are often 11 a.m. to 11 p.m.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Chilis hours on Easter Sunday vary, with many open 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. ET'
